dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, be careful with that knife. Don't cut yourself!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, bi ˈkɛrfəl wɪð ðæt ˈnaɪf. ˈdoʊnt ˈkʌt jʊrˈsɛlf!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Don't worry, I'm fine. Oh no! I cut myself!
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri, aɪm ˈfaɪn. ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈkʌt maɪˈsɛlf!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let me see. Is it bleeding?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈsiː. ɪz ɪt ˈbliːdɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, a little. It isn't bad.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ə ˈlɪtəl. ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈbæd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wash it with cold water. I'll get you a tissue.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɑːʃ ɪt wɪð ˈkoʊld ˈwɔːtər. aɪl ˈɡɛt juː ə ˈtɪʃuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, but I can do it myself.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, bʌt aɪ kən ˈduː ɪt maɪˈsɛlf.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. My dad hurt himself last week, too.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. maɪ ˈdæd ˈhɜːrt hɪmˈsɛlf ˈlæst ˈwiːk, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not badly. He fell off his bike, and his knee was bleeding.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈbædli. hiː ˈfɛl ˈɔːf hɪz ˈbaɪk, ənd hɪz ˈniː wʌz ˈbliːdɪŋ.
